name: BRAVE COLLECTIVE - BEND
address: 133 SW CENTURY DRIVE, STE 100, BEND, OR 97702

fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Walkway; Open Lawn Area; Landscaped Area
fr.considerations: Multiple Structures; Multiple Access Points; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the entrance to the detached structure clearly so responders can identify it quickly on arrival.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the street in both directions.
• Identify and mark the primary access point to each structure so responders do not lose time locating entry.
• Keep the parking areas clear of stored vehicles or equipment that would reduce space available for emergency vehicles to turn around.
• Keep walkways between the main residence and detached structure clear so responders can move between buildings without obstruction.
• Trim any landscaping that narrows or blocks the walking path between structures.
• Post the property address at the street entrance if the main residence is not visible from the road.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Scattered Shrubs; Open Green Space; Adequate Vegetation Separation; None Visible
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees within the scattered cluster nearest to the structure to increase open space between tree canopies.
• Remove any shrubs growing directly against or touching the structure's exterior walls.
• Keep scattered shrubs separated from one another to reduce connected pathways of vegetation toward the house.
• Trim low-hanging branches on trees near the structure so branches do not extend close to the roofline or walls.
• Maintain the existing open green space areas by keeping them mowed and free of accumulated dead plant material.
